Children Investment Fund

The Children Investment fund is a moderate-risk fund that allows you to invest and get annual dividend. It offers easy entry and exit, and redemption within 24 hours. Liquidation before expiration of the holding period attracts a 20% penalty fee on accrued interest.

The funds are also partly affected by fluctuations of share prices in the stock markets.

Benefits and features of Children Investment Fund:

  • Start with a minimum of just N5,000,000 and multiples of N10,000 thereafter.
  • Moderate risk and competitive return
  • Annual Dividends
  • High liquidity (24-hour redemption)
  • Minimum holding period of 365 days
  • Funds are open-ended
  • Free entry and exit
  • Opportunity to invest on behalf of minors
  • Online access to your portfolio
  • Professional expertise of Fund Manager
